explanation: A gaming console is fun but not essential — you can live and study without it, so it is a want.
You need transport to get to school or work, so a bus pass is a need.
Books and education are essential for your studies, so textbooks are a need.
Plain shoes already cover your basics — the branded pair is a want driven by style.
Food is essential for daily life and health, so groceries are a need.
Entertainment is enjoyable but optional, so a streaming subscription is a want.
